nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token handle pointing to the Tornado Cash TORN token contract (0x77777FeDdddFfC19Ff86DB637967013e6C6A116C); used for transfer and approve calls.
Immutable Vesting interface handle (0x179f48C78f57A3A78f0608cC9197B8972921d1D2) used to query vested/released amounts, start timestamp and to trigger release().
Immutable ISablier handle (0xA4fc358455Febe425536fd1878bE67FfDBDEC59a) used to create the token streaming contract.
Immutable destination address (0xb04E030140b30C27bcdfaafFFA98C57d80eDa7B4) that receives the treasury tokens and the Sablier stream.
Constant 5 (5%) share of the vested treasury allocated to the community multisig.
Constant 30 days used to convert elapsed seconds into elapsed months.
Constant 12 months used to project the yearly vesting amount.
Constant SECOND_PER_MONTH * MONTH_PER_YEAR (360 days) used both as the Sablier stream duration and as the deposit rounding modulus.
Constant 100 used as the percentage denominator for the treasury share computations.

Public, permissionless entry point that claims vested TORN, transfers 5% of already vested funds to the multisig, computes the per-month vesting rate and creates a 12-month Sablier stream with 5% of next-year vesting.
Block timestamp used to compute the elapsed vesting months and as the Sablier stream start/stop times; miner-influenceable.
External call transferring 5% of the released funds to the community multisig; executes arbitrary code in the token contract.
External call into the vesting contract that releases newly vested tokens to this proposal contract; state-changing external call.
External approval granting the Sablier contract spending rights over the adjusted deposit amount.
External call creating the Sablier token stream, pulling the approved TORN and depending on block.timestamp for the stream window.
Amount of tokens already released by the governance vesting contract; base for the 5% transfer and the per-month rate.
Number of complete months elapsed since the vesting start timestamp, derived from block.timestamp; can be zero and is used as a divisor.
Average tokens vested per elapsed month (releasedFunds / elapsedMonths).
Deposit for Sablier: 5% of the projected next-12-month vesting amount.
Deposit rounded down to a multiple of SECOND_PER_YEAR before being approved and streamed.

Arithmetic operation releasedFunds / elapsedMonths; if elapsedMonths is zero the transaction reverts (Solidity 0.8 division by zero), and the multiply/divide chain performs truncating integer arithmetic.

edges.reason: executeProposal conditionally invokes the external GOV_VESTING.release() when vestedAmount() > 0, giving the external vesting contract execution control in the middle of the proposal flow.
The GOV_VESTING state variable is the target contract on which release() is invoked.
release() is an external state-changing call whose callee could re-enter executeProposal before the released amount is consumed, a classic reentrancy window.
releasedFunds is read from GOV_VESTING.released() after the release() call.
executeProposal assigns and relies on the releasedFunds local variable.
releasedFunds flows into the TORN.transfer amount (releasedFunds * PERCENT_OF_TREASURY / HUNDRED).
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY (5) scales the transferred amount.
HUNDRED is the divisor that normalizes the 5% transfer amount.
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the recipient of the TORN.transfer call.
executeProposal performs the external token transfer before creating the Sablier stream, allowing the token contract execution control.
TORN.transfer is an external call to a token contract that could re-enter executeProposal before the stream is created.
elapsedMonths is computed from block.timestamp, making the payout sizing dependent on miner-controllable time.
SECOND_PER_MONTH is the divisor converting elapsed seconds into elapsed months.
releasedFunds is the numerator when computing vestingPerMonth.
elapsedMonths is the divisor of releasedFunds; a zero or attacker-skewed value breaks pricing and can revert the transaction (division by zero).
elapsedMonths feeds the division operation that is vulnerable to division-by-zero and truncation.
releasedFunds is the numerator of the division operation.
vestingPerMonth is multiplied by MONTH_PER_YEAR and PERCENT_OF_TREASURY with truncating integer division to produce sablierDeposit.
MONTH_PER_YEAR (12) projects the monthly vesting into a yearly figure.
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY scales the projected yearly amount by 5%.
HUNDRED normalizes the sablierDeposit percentage computation.
sablierAdjustedDeposit = sablierDeposit - sablierDeposit % SECOND_PER_YEAR, a modulo/subtraction rounding that can render the deposit zero.
SECOND_PER_YEAR is the modulus used to round the Sablier deposit down.
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the amount approved to the Sablier contract.
executeProposal performs an external TORN.approve call before creating the stream.
TORN.approve is an external call to a token contract that could re-enter executeProposal.
sablierAdjustedDeposit is passed as the deposit argument of SABLIER.createStream.
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the recipient argument of the Sablier stream.
block.timestamp is used as both startTime and the basis for stopTime of the Sablier stream, making the vesting window time-dependent on the miner-controlled timestamp.
executeProposal makes the final external call SABLIER.createStream, which pulls funds via the prior approval and can re-enter the proposal logic.
SABLIER.createStream transfers tokens from this contract and invokes an external contract, creating a reentrancy vector against executeProposal.
The SABLIER state variable is the target contract of createStream.

normalization_plan.reason: releasedFunds is a transient value derived from GOV_VESTING.released() and consumed directly as the basis of the TORN.transfer amount, so it can be normalized into that core unsafe operation.
elapsedMonths exists only to serve as the divisor of the releasedFunds/elapsedMonths operation and can be folded into that core arithmetic unsafe operation.
vestingPerMonth is an intermediate scalar local to executeProposal with no independent semantic role beyond feeding the Sablier deposit computation.
sablierDeposit is an intermediate value used only to derive the amount passed to the Sablier stream creation call and can be merged into it.
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the rounded value consecutively approved and deposited into createStream, so it normalizes into that core unsafe operation.
